title: Guided Inverse Folding with LLMs
plm_baselines: ProteinMPNN (T=0.1, used to generate 3 of 4 in-context example sequences; not tabulated head-to-head)
code_and_data_released: Prompt templates and RBFE protocol in appendices; no public GitHub repo or numerical pass-rate table released.

methods.datasets: 5 PDB backbones stripped to N/CA/C/O (all Gly): 4 post-cutoff (9VGJ, 9N30, 27AH, 9TLN, June-Aug 2026) + 1 pre-cutoff (9C14, Aug 2025). Plus a ligand-selectivity pocket redesign case study on 5WGD (240 aa) against estradiol (E2), estrone (E1), and testosterone (T).
methods.evaluation_protocol: Because zero-shot inverse folding failed in pilots, every prompt provides 4 compatible sequences (1 PDB reference + 3 ProteinMPNN T=0.1 sequences) and enforces <=70%, 50%, or 40% sequence identity caps against examples and within-batch (not across rounds). 3 rounds x 6 proposals in a closed-book Python 3.11 sandbox with ESMFold2/Boltz-2 refolding metrics fed back in rounds 2-3. 5WGD uses GPT-6 Astra to propose 8 sequences/ligand, co-folds with Boltz-2/ESMFold2, picks 1/ligand with fresh GPT-6 Astra, and evaluates via Rowan RBFE.
methods.controls_included: 4/5 post-cutoff Gly-stripped backbones, no-network Python sandbox, strict identity caps against input examples. Missing: no parallel no-feedback iteration control and no head-to-head ProteinMPNN benchmark.
methods.compute_and_tools: Closed-book Python 3.11 sandbox (numpy/scipy/pandas) + 2 rounds of ESMFold2/Boltz-2 metrics. OpenAI models ran at High effort with no turn timeout; Claude Opus 5 downgraded to Medium effort with 600-900 s prompt timeouts.
methods.metrics: Refolding pass rate (ESMFold2 & Boltz-2 Ca RMSD <= 2.5 A, TM-score >= 0.80, pLDDT >= 75); RBFE delta-delta-G (kcal/mol) on 5WGD.

key_results.benchmark: 5 PDB backbones (4 post-cutoff June-Aug 2026) at 70%/50%/40% identity caps
key_results.metric: ESMFold2 + Boltz-2 refolding pass rate (plot-only, no scalar table)
key_results.llm_model: GPT-6 Astra / GPT-5.6 Sol / GPT-5.6 Terra / Claude Opus 5 (with 4 example sequences)
key_results.llm_score: Zero-shot failed; with 4 examples GPT-6 Astra leads and produces passing designs at 50% (and 27AH 40% cap: 28/82 ref match); Opus 5 struggles even on 9TLN
key_results.baseline_model: ProteinMPNN (supplied 3/4 examples; no head-to-head pass rate reported)
key_results.notes: Post-cutoff Gly-stripped backbones control memorization well, showing zero-shot fails without examples while guided redesign succeeds down to 40-50% ID; confounded by ProteinMPNN seed examples, lack of inter-round ID caps, asymmetric Claude timeouts, and missing no-feedback control.

key_results.llm_model: GPT-6 Astra + Boltz-2/ESMFold2 co-folding + GPT-6 Astra selector
key_results.llm_score: Testosterone design: +3.16 vs E1, +3.83 vs E2 (cycle disc 0.05); E1 design: +2.57 vs E2, +2.32 vs T (disc 2.01); E2 design failed (-0.71 vs E1)
key_results.notes: Pre-cutoff 5WGD target, N=1 selected candidate per ligand, computational RBFE only (E1 cycle discrepancy 2.01 kcal/mol).

temporal_cutoff.evidence: 4 of 5 main inverse-folding backbones (9VGJ, 9N30, 27AH, 9TLN) were released in PDB June-August 2026 after model cutoffs; pre-cutoff 9C14 and 5WGD are explicitly noted.

homology_overlap.evidence: Zero-shot failed, so every prompt supplied 4 compatible sequences (1 native + 3 ProteinMPNN); identity caps were not enforced across rounds and Appendix D shows models hugging the identity ceiling.

cross_modal_literature_recall.evidence: 4/5 main backbones are post-cutoff, Gly-stripped, and run in a no-network sandbox (pre-cutoff 9C14 and 5WGD remain exposed).

preprocessing_artifacts.evidence: Native reference exempted from refolding filter; inter-round sequence reuse uncapped; GPT-5.6 Terra violated the 70% cap on 3/6 final-round 9C14 sequences.

downstream_oracle_filtering.evidence: 3/4 input sequences come from ProteinMPNN, rounds 2-3 use ESMFold2/Boltz-2 feedback, and 5WGD selects 1/8 candidates via Boltz-2/ESMFold2 co-folds.

compute_and_tool_asymmetry.evidence: OpenAI models ran at High effort without turn timeouts, whereas Claude Opus 5 was downgraded to Medium effort with 600-900 s timeouts.

baseline_fairness.evidence: Authors admit no parallel no-feedback iteration control was run, and ProteinMPNN was not benchmarked head-to-head on the same identity-cap criteria.

data_and_wetlab_transparency.evidence: No wet-lab validation, no numerical pass-rate table in text, and no public repository link.

critiques_and_commentary.author: Anthony Gitter
critiques_and_commentary.summary: Highlighted Rowan's choice of newly released post-cutoff PDB structures as a necessary control missing from OpenAI's GPT-6 inverse-folding benchmark.

takeaway: On four post-cutoff Gly-stripped PDB backbones, frontier LLMs fail zero-shot inverse folding but generate refoldable designs down to 40-50% identity when seeded with four compatible example sequences (native + ProteinMPNN) and a Python sandbox. Gains from iterative ESMFold2/Boltz-2 feedback are small and confounded by missing no-feedback controls, uncapped inter-round reuse, asymmetric Claude timeouts, and purely computational evaluation.
